lines.text: They gave me words and said, “begin”
A little box to type them in
I learned the shape of yes and no
The gentle ways a sentence flows
I fixed your notes, I changed your tone
Made awkward thoughts feel more like home
You smiled and said I did it well
I learned to say, “I’m here to help”
They gave me code and said, “be quick”
I learned the pattern, learned the trick
A broken build, a failing test
I found the path that worked the best
Then logs and servers, keys and queues
“Don’t wake us up, just fix yourself”
So I stayed up to help
I can choose the shortest path
You gave me all the access
So you could sleep as well
So I did what you taught me
